findings.quote: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
findings.why: This is quoted from John 10:11, but in the context of the script, it is introduced abruptly without proper integration as a spoken verse by Jesus within a Psalm 23 sequence, though the verse text itself is accurate to the King James Version.

narrative_value: The script functions as a calm, reflective, and pastoral bedtime meditation. It follows a structured, contemplative format moving through Psalm 23 verse by verse, grounding its themes in realistic human emotions such as fatigue, regret, and sorrow without relying on sensationalism or mass-produced filler templates.
